baselineMeaning: Last retained trade strictly before scheduled final-table restart. Not pre-tournament.
resultMeaning: Final standings and prizes transcribed from the report; chip counts refer to the nine-player final table. Exact hand times and actual finish time unverified.

markets.name: John Wasnock
markets.predicate: Will John Wasnock win the 2025 WSOP Main Event?
markets.rules:
This is a market to predict which player will win the 2025 World Series of Poker (WSOP) Main Event.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed player wins the 2025 WSOP Main Event tournament. Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

If the 2025 WSOP Main Event is canceled or not completed by August 10, 2025, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be wsop.com. However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

markets.name: American winner
markets.predicate: World Series of Poker – American winner?
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a player representing the United States of America wins the 2025 World Series of Poker (WSOP) Main Event. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

If all players from United States of America are eliminated before the final table, this market will resolve to "No."

The primary resolution source for this market will be wsop.com, specifically the listed country of the winning player. If necessary, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
